description: This file defines the AWS GlacierClient class, a client library for interacting with the Amazon Glacier service. It includes methods for various Glacier operations, middleware configuration, command customization, and API documentation enhancements.

classes.name: GlacierClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Glacier, extending AwsClient, providing methods for Glacier operations, middleware setup, and API documentation modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GlacierClient with provided options and sets up middleware for API versioning, checksums, and source file handling.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to set default 'accountId' parameter to '-' for all operations.

methods.name: getChecksumsMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware to add checksum headers for upload operations, computing tree hashes and content hashes as needed.

methods.name: getApiVersionMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware to add API version headers to all requests.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Static method to enhance API documentation, add 'SourceFile' and 'ContentSHA256' parameters info, and make 'accountId' optional.
